_comment: Mirrors .github/config/release/semantic-release.json -- this copy lives at the repo root because that is the path semantic-release auto-discovers (`.releaserc.json` is one of the default search locations). The BAUER GROUP reusable workflow may or may not pick up the .github/ copy; this guarantees the config is read.
